# v1.1.3 Beta for Minecraft 26.2.x

Just a minor fix for those playing in survival. All TAS recipes get unlocked immediately after acquiring its recipe ingredients when it was only supposed to be unlocked after acquiring one and interacting with TAS at least once.

Also, some turret recipes for the Crafting Table tend to not load or not show up until crafted due to a category error. This was fixed now in this patch.

## What's New?

releases.notes: # v1.1.2 Beta for Minecraft 26.2.x This patched version of the v1.1.2-beta is for the latest 26.2.x version of Minecraft, allowing players from the latest version to finally play the mod as well. On the recent v1.1.1-beta, bugs got through and I completely forgot to add the Missile Turret's death loot. This patch added the missing death loot alongside some fixes to some potentially hazardous (crash-level hazard) bugs preventing the mod from being played in a server. ## What's New? 🟢 Add forgotten and missing Missile Turret death loot table. 🟡 Bumped version to v1.1.2-beta. 🟡 Fix and specify the environment of some codes, allowing use of this mod in servers. 🔴 Downgrade rarity of MG Turret recipe items from UNCOMMON to COMMON. ## Pull Request & Changelog ## What's Changed * 44 turret setup teardown animation by @Virus5600 in https://github.com/Virus5600/Defensive-Measures-Mod/pull/58 * Migrate 20230624 - Migrated to 26.2.x by @Virus5600 in https://github.com/Virus5600/Defensive-Measures-Mod/pull/60 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Virus5600/Defensive-Measures-Mod/compare/v1.1.2-beta-26.x...v1.1.2-beta-26.2.x
